jobgether-jobgether:lever:16531697-ab4b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Marketing Technology & Platform Lead based in United States. This is a senior marketing technology leadership role responsible for shaping and scaling the commercial customer experience platform across HCP and patient engagement channels. You will own the martech strategy, platform roadmap, architecture, governance, and delivery model across a complex digital ecosystem. The role sits at the intersection of marketing, technology, data, analytics, and customer experience, with significant influence over long-term platform decisions. You will lead cross-functional teams and external technology partners while ensuring reliable, compliant, and scalable execution. A major focus will be optimizing Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce Data Cloud, integrations, personalization, automation, and omnichannel capabilities. You will also establish strong data, consent, security, and delivery standards that support evolving commercial needs. This is an opportunity to shape enterprise-scale digital capabilities while driving measurable improvements in customer engagement and commercial performance. Own and execute the marketing technology strategy and roadmap across Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce Data Cloud, analytics architecture, website tracking, marketing data, and related platforms, including platform selection, enhancement, replacement, and retirement decisions. Define and manage the Customer Experience Platform roadmap, enabling scalable omnichannel journeys, personalization, automation, segmentation, deliverability, and next-best-action capabilities across current and future product launches. Lead build-versus-buy assessments and develop clear, commercially sound platform recommendations for senior leadership. Manage the Customer Experience Platform development team and oversee scope, statements of work, backlogs, sprint cadence, capacity planning, delivery timelines, and priorities across launch and established brands. Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance processes, release controls, documentation requirements, and governance practices to ensure high-quality, compliant, and timely deployments. Oversee outsourced development partners and vendors, managing performance, commercial relationships, scope, escalations, renewals, capacity, and delivery quality while minimizing technical debt and vendor dependency. Own integration architecture connecting CRM, customer experience platforms, websites, paid media, search, social channels, and commercial data warehouses in collaboration with IT and Commercial Analytics. Establish a trusted data foundation across HCP and patient audiences to support accurate measurement, analytics, segmentation, targeting, and customer engagement. Partner with analytics and data teams to enable advanced segmentation, personalization, targeting, and next-best-action capabilities across execution platforms. Own platform governance covering environments, access controls, naming conventions, tagging taxonomies, consent and preference management, and release management. Define and monitor platform KPIs, including deliverability, uptime, deployment speed, data quality, capacity utilization, and operational performance. Enable new channels, dynamic content capabilities, and other emerging technologies so brand and commercial operations teams can adopt them effectively at scale. Act as the commercial counterpart to IT for platform prioritization, architecture decisions, integrations, and technology investments. Partner with brand and omnichannel leaders to ensure platform capabilities effectively support customer journeys across brands and therapeutic areas. Represent the organization with technology vendors, agencies, industry partners, and other external stakeholders while promoting strong platform standards and continuous improvement. Requirement

jobgether-jobgether:lever:dfc1bb2e-3ce0-.title: Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:dfc1bb2e-3ce0-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist based in Mexico. This is a senior creative role focused on shaping intuitive, expressive, and highly engaging interfaces for mobile games enjoyed by players around the world. You will define the visual identity of the game UI while building scalable systems that keep experiences consistent across devices and screen sizes. The role combines visual design, UX thinking, prototyping, design systems, and close collaboration with game development teams. You will transform concepts into polished interfaces, seamlessly blending 2D UI with 3D game assets while maintaining strong hierarchy and visual impact. You will also contribute to modern AI-assisted workflows that accelerate ideation, exploration, and asset creation. Success requires both artistic excellence and a systems mindset, with a strong understanding of mobile gaming conventions and player behavior. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact in a fast-moving, remote-friendly environment where creativity, experimentation, and collaboration are highly valued. Define and own the visual direction, layout, interaction patterns, and overall artistic quality of mobile game interfaces. Create high-fidelity 2D UI assets, icons, screens, menus, and interactive elements that are colorful, polished, intuitive, and optimized for mobile devices. Integrate 2D UI layers with 3D game assets while maintaining visual hierarchy, depth, readability, and a cohesive aesthetic. Build, scale, and maintain a component-driven UI design system in Figma, including reusable components, variants, variables, auto-layout structures, and responsive behaviors. Design modular and reusable UI components that account for mobile platform constraints and different screen sizes and aspect ratios. Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, interactive prototypes, and iconography that prioritize intuitive navigation, touch ergonomics, and engaging player interactions. Design interfaces for modern free-to-play meta systems, including progression tracks, Battle Passes, collection systems, rewards, and other engagement features. Collaborate closely with programmers, technical artists, producers, and other creative stakeholders to ensure designs are implemented accurately and retain their intended visual quality in-engine. Use generative AI and AI-assisted design tools to accelerate brainstorming, mood-board development, concept exploration, iteration, and asset generation. Maintain clear design documentation and communicate UI logic and design-system principles effectively to technical and creative teams. Contribute to UI animations, visual effects, and other implementation considerations where appropriate. Continuously refine the player experience by balancing visual excitement with clarity, usability, consistency, and performance. Requirements 10+ years of professional game-art experience, including at least 5 years specializing in UI/UX art. A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional mobile game UI/UX work, including visual case studies or references from at least 2 shipped mobile titles. Excellent understanding of composition, color theory, typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and stylized 2D game-art production. Deep knowledge of mobile game UI principles, including touch interfaces, gesture controls, ergonomics, and iOS/Android design considerations. Strong understanding of free-to-play game meta systems such as Battle Passes, progression tracks, collection systems, and reward loops. Expert-level proficiency with Figma, including auto-layout, nested components, variables, variants, design systems, and interactive prototyping. Strong proficiency with Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for high-fidelity asset creation, iconography, vectors, textures, and visual treatments. Proven experience creating and managing comprehensive UI design systems and style

southparkcommons-render:ashbyhq:0f8243b0.description: At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. APPLYING TO RENDER We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. ABOUT THE ROLE Render is building a channel partnerships program from the ground up, and we're hiring our first Head of Revenue Partnerships to lead it — reporting to our VP of Revenue. You'll build Render's relationships with development agencies, PE firms, and — over time — systems integrators, to help Render customers who are migrating off competitive platforms, or who are pursuing new builds with Render. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:b90ca7ea-d7e.title: Polish Linguistic Lead Tester in Cupertino, CA
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:b90ca7ea-d7e.description: About Welocalize Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale. Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com ROLE OVERVIEW We are looking for a Polish Linguistic Lead Tester to join a long-term project in Cupertino, CA. As a Linguistic Lead Tester, you’ll help bring high-quality Polish content to life and ensure it feels natural, accurate, and polished for end users. The Onsite Lead Tester is responsible for the overall quality of their language at an account level, as well as the main point of contact for Language Leads. This role is ideal for someone with native-level fluency in Polish, fluency in English, and strong communication skills. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable working with customers and stakeholders at different levels, can provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback, and confidently present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, customers, and linguists. The ideal candidate also enjoys supporting and training others, sharing knowledge, and helping the team grow, and is available to work full-time. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Linguistic tasks Coordination of the linguistic team, like for example: Reviews copy and gives feedback to testers; communicates feedback received from the client Supports testers in understanding corrections resulting from the arbitration process Acts as liaison for terminology, style issues, product features & questions Supports the onboarding of new testers Identifies linguistic-specific training needs for the language; creates, maintains, and delivers the linguistic training program Quality management planning and execution Client engagement Linguistic assets management Complete assigned tasks in a quality and timely manner. REQUIREMENTS Onsite in our offices in Cupertino, CA. W-2 (eligible for benefits based on hours worked). Monday-Friday (8:30 am - 4:30 pm, with a 1-hour lunch break, 35 hours per week). To be eligible for this role, you’ll need a valid visa permitting you to work in the USA. IDEAL BACKGROUNDS: Marketing, Journalism, Copy Editing, Proofreading, Writing, Translation, and/or Localization Benefits: ▪️ Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity Insurance ▪️ Telemedicine Benefit ▪️ Paid Sick Time ▪️ Paid Holiday ▪️ Employee Assistance Program Following the eligibility requirements: ▪️ Medical Insurance ▪️ Dental Insurance ▪️ Vision Insurance ▪️ HSA ▪️ Voluntary Life Insurance ▪️ 401(k) Retirement Plan Hourly rate: $40 Job Reference: #LI-JC1
